association_policy: fresh full-catalogue hard reassociation independently for each group at every geographic cell
timing_policy: fixed sealed group offsets of -0.75 and -0.50 seconds
model: exact causal per-NORAD rate with Gaussian fitting prior and profiled per-track CFO
geographic_objective: information-weighted regularized exact rate selection objective
transition_rule: translate at unchanged spacing while the winner is on the edge; halve only after an interior winner
postseal_policy: the geographic reference may be read only after inference.json and qualification.json are sealed
